text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered — streaming endpoint `stream/redwood-13b` p99 latency spike to ~3.2s over last 10m, error budget burn 12%. Metric: streaming_tail_latency_p99. Possible correlated GPU ECC increases on cluster az3. Link: https://metrics.example/redwood/streaming?p=stream/redwood-13b
Lina: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling logs and router state. @Miguel can you look at GPU telemetry for az3-07/az3-08?
Miguel: on it. Saw a flurry of correctable ECCs on az3-07, thermal events showing Tjunction jumps to 95C before throttling. Ordering: NVML shows repeated SM throttle entries.
Isabel: Customer-facing impact — a handful of sessions saw streaming stalls; CS reported one major customer experiencing repeated chunk stalls. Severity candidate: Sev2? we should confirm error types.
Lina: Agree Sev2 for now. Initiating incident bridge and paging PD. ops-bot: open bridge http://bridge.example/5999990000
ops-bot: PagerDuty ping sent to oncall.
Miguel: Dumping `dmesg` and `nvml` snippets. ```
[ 10234.567890] NVRM: Xid (GPU 0000:0b:00): 31, PID 12345, Graphics Engine Xid Error
NVML: ECC correctable count: +42 in last 5m on GPU 2 (az3-07)
Thermal: TJ 95C -> throttle_event -> clock reduced 25%
```
Kevin: Suggest immediate traffic shift off az3-07 to reduce error amplification. Can we drain the node gracefully?
Miguel: We can set router tag `exclude:az3-07` and drain existing sessions with `grace=30s`. Doing dry-run now.
Lina: Do it. Execute commands and post results.
Miguel: Running: ```
$ rtrctl set-tag cluster=stream/redwood-13b exclude=az3-07
OK: tag applied to pool-stream-az3-07
$ rtrctl drain pool-stream-az3-07 --grace 30s
Draining 48 sessions -> should fallback to pool-stream-az3-08 and fallback-dedicated
```
Isabel: Noting customer impact: spike correlates with a retry storm from client SDKs hitting p95 timeouts -> increased concurrent tokens per session. Flagging for product to follow up. @Lina
Lina: Observed fallback to pool-stream-az3-08 but p99 still ~1.8s — better but above SLO. Enabling autoscale burst for dedicated fallback pool.
ops-bot: Autoscale API: `POST /scalers/stream-dedicated/scale?priority=burst&delta=+4` -> accepted.
Miguel: After drain, ECC counts on az3-07 stopped growing but existing GPU shows repeated correctables; recommend offline reprovision for hardware diag.
Kevin: Approving offline. @ops-bot can we cordon az3-07 from scheduler so no new workloads land?
ops-bot: Cordon applied: `scheduler mark --node az3-07 --state cordoned`
Isabel: Filing customer incident note: customers A/B/C affected with degraded streaming; CS notified with ETA 30min for mitigation.
Lina: Quick triage notes: probable root = thermal + sustained workload causing ECC correctables which triggered SM throttling -> KV cache thrash -> streaming tail latency. Short-term mitigations: 1) Drain/cordon node, 2) Route to fallback + autoscale, 3) Raise client timeouts if possible.
Miguel: Post-mitigation telemetry: p99 down to 700ms after autoscale but some p95 jitter remains. ECC counts stable. Reviewing node logs for firmware errors.
Kevin: Recommend follow-up actions: hardware replacement for GPU 2 on az3-07, firmware update if vendor has patch, add thermal alert thresholds earlier.
Isabel: I've updated the incident tracker with customer impact and timeline. CS provided an interim workaround doc to affected customers.
Lina: Preparing RCA skeleton: timeline, telemetry, mitigation, short/long term fixes. Assigning owners: Miguel -> hardware triage and vendor contact; Kevin -> infra changes (thermal alert thresholds, scheduler policies); Isabel -> customer comms + postmortem draft.
Miguel: Reaching out to vendor now, collecting serials and ECC dump. Attaching logs to bridge.
pagerduty: Incident escalated to SRE lead.
Lina: Wrapping up live mitigation. Will keep bridge open for postmortem prep. Final p99 at 300ms, error budget burn stabilized. Closing paging for oncall rotation in 10m.
Isabel: +1 on closing. Add action item: add simulated burst test to detect ECC progression earlier in staging.
Kevin: Noted. Will schedule a runbook update and add a pre-mitigation play: `drain -> cordon -> autoscale` in that order.
Lina: Thanks everyone. Logging final notes and switching to post-incident mode. :white_check_mark:
